encoder_method_note:
The message is carried by the ten building rectangles in the skyline, read left to right: each building's `height` attribute is ten times the alphabet position of a letter (a=1 … z=26), so 130, 50, 50, 200, 10, 200, 40, 10, 230, 140 decode to m, e, e, t, a, t, d, a, w, n. Word breaks are indicated structurally by the horizontal spacing: buildings within a word are separated by a 10px gap, while the two 40px gaps mark the spaces, grouping the buildings 4–2–4 into "meet at dawn". The 10px-period window pattern reinforces the unit, since the number of window rows on each building equals the same letter index.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="480" height="300" viewBox="0 0 480 300">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#182446"/>
      <stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#5b4a7d"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#d9825f"/>
      <stop offset="0.9" stop-color="#f7b36a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffd98a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="glow">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff0bf" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffb347" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <pattern id="win" width="10" height="10" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="10" height="10" fill="#1d1f3a"/>
      <rect x="3" y="3" width="4" height="4" fill="#e6a94f" fill-opacity="0.7"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <rect width="480" height="300" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="262" r="90" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="262" r="36" fill="#ffd27a"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#1d1f3a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M58 82q7-7 14 0q7-7 14 0"/>
    <path d="M96 64q6-6 12 0q6-6 12 0"/>
    <path d="M82 104q5-5 10 0q5-5 10 0"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="url(#win)">
    <rect x="30" y="130" width="30" height="130"/>
    <rect x="70" y="210" width="20" height="50"/>
    <rect x="100" y="210" width="20" height="50"/>
    <rect x="130" y="60" width="40" height="200"/>
    <rect x="210" y="250" width="20" height="10"/>
    <rect x="240" y="60" width="40" height="200"/>
    <rect x="320" y="220" width="30" height="40"/>
    <rect x="360" y="250" width="20" height="10"/>
    <rect x="390" y="30" width="40" height="230"/>
    <rect x="440" y="120" width="30" height="140"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="0" y="260" width="480" height="40" fill="#141631"/>
</svg>
